status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.TT6B/g0/r0: Joseph: Are you all right, Mary? Mary: Somehow… Kashim looks miserable. Joseph: He'll be fine. A little water will perk him right up.
changes.TT6B/g0/r1: He has no idea how I feel.
changes.TT6B/g0/r2: Barren land stretches as far as I can see.
changes.TT6B/g0/r5: She looks at me with concern.
changes.TT6B/g0/r6: My joints ache. I'm starving… and my throat is bone-dry.
changes.TT6B/g0/r7: Heavy… exhausted… starving… I can't take another step.
changes.TT6B/g0/r8: Mary: Kashim! Joseph: Stay with us! Me: Hee-haw…
changes.TT6B/g0/r10: Joseph: That's strange… Mary: What is it? Joseph: We should be able to see the town by now. We must have lost our way.
changes.TT6B/g0/r11: Mary: We have no food and no water. Joseph: And it'll be dark soon…
changes.TT6B/g0/r12: Dust fills my nostrils. Me: Mmmph…
changes.TT6B/g0/r13: Sniff… Oh! Sniff… That's hay! There must be a house nearby!
changes.TT6B/g0/r14: The smell of hay tickles my nose.
changes.TT6B/g0/r19: Me: Pant… pant… Joseph: Ah! Your water! Sorry, I forgot. He uncorks the canteen. Me: Oh… it's already empty. Me: Hee-haw!
changes.TT6B/g0/r20: Joseph: There's none left. Hang in there. Me: Brrrr…
changes.TT6B/g0/r22: Me: Hee-haw! I bolt off at a run.
changes.TT6B/g0/r29: Camel: What's the matter? Me: Can I eat some of that hay? Camel: Sure. Help yourself.
changes.TT6B/g0/r31: Camel: Of these three, one always tells the truth. One always lies. And one lies only sometimes—the unreliable one.
changes.TT6B/g1/r0: Joseph: Hello? Is anyone there? Voice: What do you want?
changes.TT6B/g1/r1: Joseph: We're trying to reach Bethlehem…
changes.TT6B/g1/r2: Right: Go due east. Middle: Go due north. Left: Go due west.
changes.TT6B/g1/r3: Right: The one in the middle is not the unreliable one. Middle: The one on the left is not the honest one. Left: The one on the right is not the liar.
changes.TT6B/g1/r6: Me: Hee-haw! Joseph: I trust you, Kashim.
changes.TT6B/g1/r8: I have to be careful not to jostle Mary.
changes.TT6B/g1/r9: Joseph: Good old Kashim. Mary: Truly.
changes.TT6B/g1/r10: "Bethlehem lies ahead." Joseph: We made it!
changes.TT6B/g1/r11: Meanwhile, a star was guiding three travelers toward Bethlehem.
changes.TT6B/g1/r13: Innkeeper: We're full. Joseph: Please… Innkeeper: Sleep by the road. Joseph: Please! The baby is coming now! Innkeeper: Fine, fine. You can use the stable. Joseph: Thank you!
changes.TT6B/g1/r14: Man: This must be the place. Man: At last…
changes.TT6B/g1/r17: Moonlight falls across her face. She looks like an angel.
changes.TT6B/g1/r22: She looks hard to approach. Cow: You got a problem?
changes.TT6B/g1/r23: This can only be… Cow: Shit is shit.
changes.TT6B/g1/r25: Mare: Rome? Who cares? Its day will come.
changes.TT6B/g1/r26: Mare: Don't get too familiar. You and I are not of the same rank.
changes.TT6B/g1/r27: Sheep: Far to the east, they say there's a Demon-Sealing Jar that can imprison devils.
changes.TT6B/g1/r28: Sheep: "Doubt is the key to wisdom." An old Arab proverb.
changes.TT6B/g1/r29: Sheep: Know the answer to this one?
changes.TT6B/g1/r30: What forbidden fruit did Eve eat?
changes.TT6B/g2/r0: What is the name of the one God worshiped in Judaism?
changes.TT6B/g2/r1: From what country did Moses lead the Israelites out?
changes.TT6B/g2/r2: Which Jewish king built the Temple in Jerusalem?
changes.TT6B/g2/r3: What word for "Savior" means "the anointed one"?
changes.TT6B/g2/r4: Sheep: Correct! Every one! Well done.
changes.TT6B/g2/r6: Cow: I don't know much, but something big is coming. Call it animal instinct.
changes.TT6B/g2/r7: Cow: How do I put this… What can I say… To make it simple… Long story short…
changes.TT6B/g2/r9: I'm already stuffed… and now I'm getting sleepy.
changes.TT6B/g2/r10: There are so many of them, but it's strangely quiet.
changes.TT6B/g2/r11: Joseph: Hold on, Mary. Mary: I will…
changes.TT6B/g2/r15: Ask before you eat somebody else's food!
changes.TT6B/g2/r18: Mare: No nibbling. If you're going to eat, commit to it! Me: Y-yes…
changes.TT6B/g2/r21: I'm stuffed. I couldn't eat another bite.
changes.TT6B/g2/r24: Mare: You're a lively one, aren't you?
